premise: Lola and Dog's picnic is rained on; they squeeze under the umbrella, Dog dashes out and comes back to shake all over Lola, and a rainbow makes it all worthwhile.
inspiration: The weathered-picnic of nursery stories, played for laughs: the rain is a game, the wet dog the joke, the rainbow the reward.
lesson: A spoiled plan can turn into the best part.

en-US.title: The Rainy Picnic
en-US.text: {umbrella:enter} {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} Lola and {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} Dog were having a picnic on the sand. {girl:face happy} {dog:live wag-tail} Then… plip. Plop. {canvas:rain 0.8 18s} {sfx:rain} Pitter-patter! Rain! {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [excited] "Quick, Dog! Under the umbrella!" {girl:go under umbrella} {dog:go under umbrella} {girl:live crouch hold} They squeezed in under the big red-and-white umbrella. {umbrella:pulse} Tap, tap, tap went the rain on top. {girl:face happy} Cosy! {dog:live play-bow} But Dog couldn't sit still. {dog:go to girl right} Out he dashed into the rain, {dog:face happy} round and round. Then back he came, {dog:go under umbrella} dripping wet, {dog:live shake} and SHOOK, right next to Lola. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [laughs] "Dog! Now I'm wetter than the rain!" [short pause] {canvas:rain stop} Then the rain stopped. {umbrella:live spin} The umbrella gave a little spin, flicking off the last drops. {canvas:rainbow 14s} [gasps] And there, over the bay, was a rainbow. {girl:face happy} {dog:face happy} {girl:says} [softly] "Worth getting wet for." {dog:hearts}

es-ES.title: El picnic con lluvia
es-ES.text: {umbrella:enter} {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} Lola y {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} Perro estaban de picnic en la arena. {girl:face happy} {dog:live wag-tail} Entonces… plic. Ploc. {canvas:rain 0.8 18s} {sfx:rain} ¡Tip-tap! ¡Lluvia! {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [excited] «¡Rápido, Perro! ¡Debajo de la sombrilla!» {girl:go under umbrella} {dog:go under umbrella} {girl:live crouch hold} Se apretujaron bajo la gran sombrilla roja y blanca. {umbrella:pulse} Tac, tac, tac, hacía la lluvia encima. {girl:face happy} ¡Qué a gustito! {dog:live play-bow} Pero Perro no podía estarse quieto. {dog:go to girl right} Salió corriendo bajo la lluvia, {dog:face happy} vueltas y más vueltas. Luego volvió, {dog:go under umbrella} chorreando, {dog:live shake} y se SACUDIÓ justo al lado de Lola. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [laughs] «¡Perro! ¡Ahora estoy más mojada que la lluvia!» [short pause] {canvas:rain stop} Luego dejó de llover. {umbrella:live spin} La sombrilla dio una vueltecita, sacudiéndose las últimas gotas. {canvas:rainbow 14s} [gasps] Y allí, sobre la bahía, apareció un arcoíris. {girl:face happy} {dog:face happy} {girl:says} [softly] «Ha merecido la pena mojarse.» {dog:hearts}

ja-JP.title: あめの ピクニック
ja-JP.text: {umbrella:enter}{girl:enter}{girl:go to sand}ローラと{dog:enter}{dog:go to sand}イヌくんは、砂浜で、ピクニックをしていました。{girl:face happy}{dog:live wag-tail}すると…ぽつん。ぽつん。{canvas:rain 0.8 18s}{sfx:rain}ぱらぱらぱら！あめです！{girl:face surprised}{girl:says}[excited]「イヌくん、はやく！パラソルのしたへ！」 {girl:go under umbrella}{dog:go under umbrella}{girl:live crouch hold}赤と白の、大きなビーチパラソルのしたに、ぎゅうぎゅうもぐりこみました。{umbrella:pulse}あめが、うえで、とん、とん、とん。{girl:face happy}ぬくぬく！{dog:live play-bow}でも、イヌくんは、じっとしていられません。{dog:go to girl right}あめのなかへとびだして、{dog:face happy}ぐるぐる、ぐるぐる。それから、{dog:go under umbrella}びしょぬれでもどってきて、{dog:live shake}ローラのすぐよこで、ぶるぶるぶるっ！{girl:face happy}{girl:says}[laughs]「イヌくんったら！あめより、びっしょびしょ！」 [short pause]{canvas:rain stop}やがて、あめがやみました。{umbrella:live spin}パラソルが、くるっとまわって、さいごのしずくを、ぴっぴっ。{canvas:rainbow 14s}[gasps]海のむこうに、にじがかかっています。{girl:face happy}{dog:face happy}{girl:says}[softly]「ぬれても、よかったね」 {dog:hearts}

de-DE.title: Picknick im Regen
de-DE.text: {umbrella:enter} {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} Lola und {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} der Hund machten ein Picknick im Sand. {girl:face happy} {dog:live wag-tail} Doch dann… plitsch. Platsch. {canvas:rain 0.8 18s} {sfx:rain} Pitsch-patsch! Regen! {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [excited] „Schnell, Hund! Unter den Sonnenschirm!“ {girl:go under umbrella} {dog:go under umbrella} {girl:live crouch hold} Sie quetschten sich unter den großen rot-weißen Schirm. {umbrella:pulse} Tropf, tropf, tropf machte der Regen oben drauf. {girl:face happy} Gemütlich! {dog:live play-bow} Aber der Hund konnte nicht still sitzen. {dog:go to girl right} Hinaus flitzte er in den Regen, {dog:face happy} rundherum und rundherum. Dann kam er zurück, {dog:go under umbrella} tropfnass, {dog:live shake} und SCHÜTTELTE sich, direkt neben Lola. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [laughs] „Hund! Jetzt bin ich ja nasser als der Regen!“ [short pause] {canvas:rain stop} Dann hörte der Regen auf. {umbrella:live spin} Der Schirm drehte sich ein bisschen und schleuderte die letzten Tropfen ab. {canvas:rainbow 14s} [gasps] Und da, über der Bucht, stand ein Regenbogen. {girl:face happy} {dog:face happy} {girl:says} [softly] „Dafür lohnt es sich, nass zu werden.“ {dog:hearts}

fr-FR.title: Pique-nique sous la pluie
fr-FR.text: {umbrella:enter} {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} Lola et {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} Chien pique-niquaient sur le sable. {girl:face happy} {dog:live wag-tail} Et puis… plic. Ploc. {canvas:rain 0.8 18s} {sfx:rain} Plic, ploc, plic, ploc ! Il pleut ! {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [excited] « Vite, Chien ! Sous le parasol ! » {girl:go under umbrella} {dog:go under umbrella} {girl:live crouch hold} Ils se sont serrés sous le grand parasol rouge et blanc. {umbrella:pulse} Tap, tap, tap, faisait la pluie là-haut. {girl:face happy} Bien au chaud, bien à l’abri ! {dog:live play-bow} Mais Chien ne tenait pas en place. {dog:go to girl right} Il a filé sous la pluie, {dog:face happy} et il a tourné, tourné, tourné. Puis il est revenu, {dog:go under umbrella} tout trempé, {dog:live shake} et il s’est SECOUÉ, juste à côté de Lola. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [laughs] « Chien ! Maintenant, je suis plus mouillée que la pluie ! » [short pause] {canvas:rain stop} Puis la pluie s’est arrêtée. {umbrella:live spin} Le parasol a fait un petit tour sur lui-même, pour secouer les dernières gouttes. {canvas:rainbow 14s} [gasps] Et là, au-dessus de la baie, il y avait un arc-en-ciel. {girl:face happy} {dog:face happy} {girl:says} [softly] « Ça valait bien une petite douche. » {dog:hearts}

it-IT.title: Il picnic sotto la pioggia
it-IT.text: {umbrella:enter} {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} Lola e {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} Cane facevano un picnic sulla sabbia. {girl:face happy} {dog:live wag-tail} Poi… plic. Ploc. {canvas:rain 0.8 18s} {sfx:rain} Tic tic tic! Piove! {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [excited] «Presto, Cane! Sotto l'ombrellone!» {girl:go under umbrella} {dog:go under umbrella} {girl:live crouch hold} Si sono stretti stretti sotto il grande ombrellone bianco e rosso. {umbrella:pulse} Tac, tac, tac, faceva la pioggia lì sopra. {girl:face happy} Che bello, stare al riparo! {dog:live play-bow} Ma Cane non riusciva a stare fermo. {dog:go to girl right} È schizzato fuori sotto la pioggia, {dog:face happy} a correre in tondo. Poi è tornato, {dog:go under umbrella} bagnato fradicio, {dog:live shake} e si è SCROLLATO tutto, proprio accanto a Lola. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [laughs] «Cane! Adesso sono più bagnata della pioggia!» [short pause] {canvas:rain stop} Poi ha smesso di piovere. {umbrella:live spin} L'ombrellone ha fatto una giravolta, scrollandosi di dosso le ultime gocce. {canvas:rainbow 14s} [gasps] Ed ecco, sopra la baia, un arcobaleno. {girl:face happy} {dog:face happy} {girl:says} [softly] «Valeva proprio la pena bagnarsi.» {dog:hearts}

zh-TW.title: 下雨天的野餐
zh-TW.text: {umbrella:enter}{girl:enter}{girl:go to sand}蘿拉和{dog:enter}{dog:go to sand}小狗在沙灘上野餐。{girl:face happy}{dog:live wag-tail}忽然……滴。答。{canvas:rain 0.8 18s}{sfx:rain}滴滴答答！下西北雨了！{girl:face surprised}{girl:says}[excited]「狗狗，快！躲到遮陽傘下面！」 {girl:go under umbrella}{dog:go under umbrella}{girl:live crouch hold}他們一起擠進紅白條紋的大遮陽傘底下。{umbrella:pulse}雨點打在傘頂上，答、答、答。{girl:face happy}好舒服喔！{dog:live play-bow}可是小狗坐不住。{dog:go to girl right}牠一溜煙衝進雨裡，{dog:face happy}繞呀繞、轉圈圈。然後牠跑回來，{dog:go under umbrella}全身濕答答的，{dog:live shake}就在蘿拉旁邊，用力甩、甩、甩！{girl:face happy}{girl:says}[laughs]「狗狗！我現在比雨還要濕啦！」 [short pause]{canvas:rain stop}後來，雨停了。{umbrella:live spin}遮陽傘輕輕轉了一圈，把最後幾滴雨甩掉。{canvas:rainbow 14s}[gasps]你看，海灣上出現了一道彩虹。{girl:face happy}{dog:face happy}{girl:says}[softly]「淋濕也值得了。」 {dog:hearts}
